decisions.decision: The board decided to continue giving wet signatures rather than using DocuSign for decisions.
decisions.quote: discussed utilizing docusign for decisions. board decided to continue to give wet signatures.

decisions.decision: The consensus on Section 250-6.4 (Driveways & Entrances) was to maintain a maximum of four lots for residential common driveways.
decisions.quote: the consensus was to maintain a maximum of four for residential lots to limit the intensity of development while allowing for some flexibility.

decisions.decision: Common driveway regulations would not be applied retroactively to existing properties and would affect only new developments.
decisions.quote: it was confirmed that these regulations wouldn't be retroactively applied to existing properties but would only affect new developments.

decisions.decision: The board will consider revising the Solar Bylaw to base regulations on square footage rather than kilowatts.
decisions.quote: board will consider revising the solar bylaw to base regulations on square footage rather than kilowatts
